gloss: to forget to turn off; to forget to erase

definitions.gloss: to forget to turn off, switch off, or erase
definitions.explanation: Compound of {消|け}す (to turn off, erase) and {忘|わす}れる (to forget), meaning to leave something on, lit, or unerased because one forgot to switch it off or erase it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to turn off the light.

examples.japanese: ⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し⟦{忘|わす}れていない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧になった。
examples.english: I got worried that I might have forgotten to turn off the stove.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧まま⟦{出|で}かけて→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧しまい、⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きたら⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{寒|さむ}かった→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: I left the house having forgotten to turn off the air conditioner, and the room was cold when I got back.

notes:
{消|け}し{忘|わす}れる combines the stem of ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ (to turn off, erase) with ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ (to forget), following the common verb-stem + ⟦{忘|わす}れる→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ pattern for "forget to do X."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し{忘|わす}れる: to forget to turn off the light
- ⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し{忘|わす}れる: to forget to turn off the stove
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{消|け}し{忘|わす}れる: to forget to turn off the air conditioner

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marking the thing left on or unerased, same as ⟦{消|け}す→消す：00528_kesu⟧ itself.
